Name: AccessChestAnywhere
Author: dumb0t
Description:
Access your chests from anywhere. Transfer items without having to run around, from the comfort of your bed to the deepest level of mine.
Press 'B' to open menu
Blacklist: rename chest to include 'ignore'
[url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/access-chest-anywhere-smapi-0-39-xx.112555]More info here[/url]

[b]Installation[/b]
unzip file to mods folder

[b]Requirements[/b]
[url=https://github.com/ClxS/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI(0.39.5+) to be able to use mods[/url]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/242/?]Chest Label System by OrSpeeder (recommended)[/url]
